description: D9-5 common data-scope policy shared by NF_AC/GAUSS_DIAG/GAUSS_FULL/GMM within a track. Resolved concrete shard names/hashes/row counts are recorded at audit time in artifacts/afterms_d9_5_model_family_arena_v0/data_scope/data_scope_manifest.json, never here -- this file is the frozen policy, not the resolved evidence.
shard_scope_note: all shards listed in shard_manifest.json for each split (22 train / 3 validation / 3 test); no row subsampling; shard selection does not depend on any model metric.
excluded_tracks_note: log1p-pz and production-weighted tracks are out of scope for D9-5 (weighting interpretation remains OPEN); never pooled across TRK_PDG13_UW_ID and TRK_PDGM13_UW_ID.
test_isolation_note: test rows may only be read by d9_5.evaluation after a family_selection_manifest freeze exists; validation and fitting code paths never open a test shard.
